questions: In fully visible frames, does the component maintain the normal upright/stable posture, with the red cap facing upward or visible on top rather than sideways?
Is the component free from side-lying posture, falling, tumbling, rolling, or strong unstable wobbling?
Are the red cap and pin side in a standard upright relationship, with no clear 90-degree sideways rotation or flipped posture compared with the normal reference?
Does the component translate smoothly from LEFT to RIGHT without stopping, moving backward, or drifting erratically?
Does the component remain fully on the belt surface, without overhanging, falling, or leaving the conveyor?
